title: Sindhu Claims Japan Open Title, Silencing Doubters With Resurgent Performance
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's victory at the Japan Open marks a significant return to form for the Indian star, answering critics and boosting national hopes.
summary: PV Sindhu secured her maiden Japan Open title with a dominant win over Akane Yamaguchi, a victory she described as emotional after a period of self-doubt and questions about her career.

title: Ayush Shetty Advances at China Open, Defeating Alwi Farhan in Promising Display
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Ayush Shetty showcased his potential by overcoming a strong opponent at the China Open, indicating a bright future for Indian badminton.
summary: Rising Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty defeated Malaysia's Alwi Farhan in a notable performance at the China Open Super 1000, marking his progress in a battle of future stars.

title: BAI Implements New 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India's decision to adopt the 3x15 scoring system for junior domestic events will significantly impact player development and match dynamics across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, starting immediately.

title: Delhi Prepares to Host BWF World Championships 2026, Calls for Gen Z Engagement
indian_angle: India hosting the prestigious BWF World Championships in Delhi presents a monumental opportunity to showcase the sport and engage a new generation of fans within the country.
summary: With the BWF World Championships 2026 set to be held in Delhi, there's a focus on attracting younger audiences, Gen Z and Gen Alpha, to ensure the long-term growth and popularity of badminton in India.

title: Kidambi Srikanth Finishes Runner-Up at US Open, Shows Strong Form
indian_angle: Kidambi Srikanth's journey to the US Open final highlights his enduring skill and competitive spirit, bringing pride to Indian badminton fans.
summary: Indian shuttler Kidambi Srikanth reached the final of the US Open, ultimately falling short against Su Li Yang, but demonstrating a return to strong form throughout the tournament.

title: Rounak Chouhan Stuns World No. 6 Chou Tien Chen at US Open
indian_angle: Rounak Chouhan's impressive upset victory over a top-ranked player at the US Open signals the emergence of another promising talent from India.
summary: Indian shuttler Rounak Chouhan, a self-proclaimed Cristiano Ronaldo fan, caused a major upset at the US Open Super 300 by defeating World No. 6 Chou Tien Chen, showcasing his potential on the international stage.
